name: Prateek Manjunath
tagline: Machine learning & data science, plus embedded telemetry on ESP32.

featured.title: A-OBD Scanner
featured.blurb: A pocket-sized live dashboard, data logger and CAN tool for an electric scooter: an OLED on the device, and a phone or PC dashboard over its own Wi-Fi.

featured.title: Customer Churn Prediction
featured.blurb: Predicts telecom customer churn with Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM, using SMOTE for class imbalance and ROC-AUC to compare them.

featured.title: Optuna vs GridSearch
featured.blurb: Tunes an XGBoost classifier three ways (Optuna, GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV) and compares accuracy and ROC-AUC.
